name: 8 Coil Shakti two-phase: chirp both sides, then hippocampus right
origin: Todd Murphy (8 Coil Shakti software); signal templates licensed from Persinger & Koren
summary: One of Todd Murphy's 'as seen on TV' two-phase sessions for the 8 Coil Shakti: the chirp over both temporal lobes for 20 min, then the hippocampal signal over the right temporal lobe for 20 min. Murphy states that the hippocampal signal on the right in phase 2 gives non-verbal calm and imagery. Both signals are stand-ins.
notes: The vendor's page lists the chirp on both sides (left channel), then the hippocampus signal on the right side only (right channel) (output_1_bi_mod40_chirp__2_r_hipp.htm). Its setup sentence describes the left-ending layout; this program follows its header and photos (right-ending). The 20 + 20 min rests on the demo video (captions at 2:34), not on the page. Phase 1 drives the two left-channel pairs (FTT7h, TTP9h on the left; FTT8h, TTP10h on the right), phase 2 the right-channel cross (FT8, C6, TP8, T10). Sites and polarity are this project's reading of the page's photos: FTT7h, TTP10h, C6 and FT8 are reversed. The chirp is a 40 to 6 Hz sweep, 837 points of 3 ms every 4 s (the Thomas pattern's length, Dixon 2001 p.4 [90]). The vendor describes gaps inside a modulated 40 Hz signal instead ('this one is not a pulse'). The hippocampal signal is the primed burst: one pulse, then four pulses 170 ms later, three times in 0.74 s (after Tsang 2004 p.5 [1017]), then 4 s of silence. Both signals stand in for unpublished vendor files. The vendor's 10 to 50 mG carries no distance (measurement.htm, duds.htm); an independent meter read 0.1 to 1.0 uT RMS about 9 cm from the coils (Gendle 2012 p.11 [227]). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. The effects are vendor claims. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). The chirp can be 'very unpleasant over the right side'; Skip goes to phase 2. On headache or pressure, lower the intensity by one third. If anxiety or fear appears during or after phase 2, do not use it again; not for people prone to anxiety. Not for anyone with epilepsy, a psychiatric condition or medication, migraine or brain injury, or on drugs. Stop on fear or distress.
setting: Darkness and acoustic silence ('not just quiet'), at night; eyes closed or blindfolded; relax without meditating or falling asleep. A helper can press Skip or Stop so you stay in the dark. The vendor: 'You don't have to use sensory deprivation if you're looking for after-effects.'
schedule: Vendor: while trying sessions out, at most every 72 h; once you settle on a session, once a week; never on consecutive days. For sessions of an hour or more (the 60-min run) the demo video and the safety pages say once every 3 weeks (one week if the session had no effect), but the vendor's 60-minute page exempts two-phase sessions from that rule.
